tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// spyan ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ lo tsa nā sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ spyan ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs bzhugs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po thog mar rnal 'byor pas kha dang gdong la sogs pa dag par bkrus nas/ chos bdag med pa dran par byas la/ snying rje chen pos brlan pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ snying gar lam̐ gyi yi ge las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi snang bas/ lha mo spyan sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang lhan cig pa spyan drangs la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya'o// de nas swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms nas/ slar yang padma dang zla ba'i steng du bsgom par bya ba'i tshul ni/ lam̐ gyi yig 'brus bsgrubs pa ste// rgyal ba thams cad kyis kyang brgyan// lha mo spyan gsum phyag brgyad ma// zhal gsum gser gyi mdog dang mtshungs// sgeg mo'i cha lugs legs 'chang ma// cung zad bzhad dang 'dod chen ma// dang po'i phyag ni mchog sbyin mdzad// de bzhin gnyis pa mi 'jigs sbyin// phyag gsum pa ni rdo rje ste// bzhi pa yis ni mda' yang gsor// g.yon pas sdigs mdzub zhags pa can// rin chen nyi ma gnyis pa na// gsum pa na ni bgrang phreng ste// bzhi pa gzhu yis rnam par brgyan// 'od 'bar 'od zer phreng ba can// lha rnams 'jigs pas sems myos te// lag pas thal mo sbyar bar byed// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprin 'phro ba// ye shes rdo rje spyan ma bsam// rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste// sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas klubs// byang chub yan lag 'bras bus brgyan// sems can kun la gzigs pa mo// lha mo 'di 'dra bsgom par bya// de nas de'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis byin gyi brlabs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang ro gcig par byas te/

dbang bskur nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par blta'o// de nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse bkug pa mthe bong gnyis la sbyar ba mig gi tshul du byas pa 'dis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas rab tu brtan par bya'o// de nas 'di'i gsang sngags bzla ba'i phyir/ snying gar zla ba kha sbyar ba'i nang du son pa'i lam̐ gyi yi ge las 'od zer srad bu'i rnam pa'i sngags byung nas/ yongs su bkris par bsam zhing*/ oṃ bha ga wa tī ru ru sphu ru/ dzwā la tiṣṭhā siddha lo tsa nī/ sarba artha sā dha na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags ci nus pa'i bzlas brjod bya'o// gsang sngags 'di ni bzlas tsam gyis// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams dgyes// bdud kyi dpung rnams 'dar 'gyur te// sangs rgyas rdo rje rjes dran byed// zhi ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi yum// rdo rje dam tshig gis bskul nas// shi ba rnams la srog sbyin mdzad// ma grub rnams la grub pa stsol// bla med rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas// sems can kun la legs gzigs ma// spyan gyi sgrub thabs byas pa yis// 'gro bas ye shes spyan thob shog /bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas spyan phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs 'di ni 'phags pas sa pho rta'i lo/ dbyu gu'i zla ba la sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
